name: Princess Elsa
dimensions: Height 820 mm; Width 780 mm; Depth 100 mm
summary: The ‘Elsa’ dress with its colourful, shiny, layers, glittery cameo and flowing cape, is the latest fairy tale costume in the 300-year history of children’s fancy dress in Britain. The Disney character, ‘Elsa’, the Snow Queen from the animated film ‘Frozen’, has been incredibly popular with children.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
